question_tamil: நீ நேற்று என்னை பார்க்க வந்தபோது நான் வீட்டில் இல்லை, ஆனால் இன்று மாலை நாம் கண்டிப்பாக சந்திக்கலாம்.
tamil_transliteration: Nee naetru ennai paarkka vandhapodhu naan veettil illai, aanal indru maalai naam kandippaaga sandhikkalaam.
options: I was not at home when you came to see me yesterday, but we can definitely meet this evening.
I saw you yesterday at my house, so let us meet today evening without fail.
When you come to my house today, I will not be there, so come tomorrow evening.
Why didn't you come to my house yesterday evening to meet me?
correct_answer: I was not at home when you came to see me yesterday, but we can definitely meet this evening.

question_tamil: மழை அதிகமாக பெய்து கொண்டிருந்ததால் என்னால் நேரத்திற்கு அலுவலகத்திற்கு வர முடியவில்லை.
tamil_transliteration: Mazhai adhigamaaga peydhu kondirundhadhaal ennaal naerathirku aluvalagathirku vara mudiyavillai.
options: Because it was raining heavily, I was unable to come to the office on time.
It started raining after I reached the office late this morning.
If it rains heavily today, I will not be able to go to the office on time.
Due to heavy traffic and rain, everyone arrived at the office very late.
correct_answer: Because it was raining heavily, I was unable to come to the office on time.

question_tamil: உனக்கு ஏதேனும் உதவி தேவைப்பட்டால் தயங்காமல் என்னை எப்போது வேண்டுமானாலும் அழைக்கலாம்.
tamil_transliteration: Unakku aedhaenum udhavi thevaippattaal thayangaamal ennai eppodhu vaendumaanaalum alaikkalaam.
options: If you need any help, feel free to call me whenever you want without hesitation.
Do not hesitate to ask anyone for help whenever you are in trouble.
Call me right now if you want me to help you with this difficult task.
I will call you whenever I need your help with this project.
correct_answer: If you need any help, feel free to call me whenever you want without hesitation.

question_tamil: நான் இந்த வேலையை முடித்த பிறகு உனக்கு உடனடியாக தொலைபேசியில் அழைக்கிறேன்.
tamil_transliteration: Naan indha vaelaiyai muditha piragu unakku udanadiyaaga tholaipaesiyil alaikkiraen.
options: I will call you immediately on the phone after I finish this work.
Please call me on the phone as soon as you complete your work.
I am currently working, so do not call my phone until I am finished.
After calling you, I will start working on this new task immediately.
correct_answer: I will call you immediately on the phone after I finish this work.

question_tamil: நீ நன்றாக படித்தால் மட்டுமே இந்த கடினமான தேர்வில் அதிக மதிப்பெண்கள் பெற முடியும்.
tamil_transliteration: Nee nandraaga padithaal mattumae indha kadinamaana thaervil adhiga madhippengal pera mudiyum.
options: Only if you study well, you can score high marks in this difficult exam.
Even if you study hard, this exam is too difficult to get good marks.
You studied very well, so you will definitely clear this exam easily.
Prepare well for the exam because getting high marks is very important.
correct_answer: Only if you study well, you can score high marks in this difficult exam.

question_tamil: நாங்கள் கடையில் வாங்கிய பொருட்கள் அனைத்தும் மிகவும் தரமாகவும் குறைந்த விலையிலும் இருந்தன.
tamil_transliteration: Naangal kadaiyil vaangiya porutkal anaithum migavum tharamaagavum kuraindha vilaiyilum irundhana.
options: All the items we bought at the shop were of high quality and at a low price.
The shop where we bought these items offers huge discounts on every product.
We should buy products that are low in price regardless of their quality.
The items bought from that shop were expensive but very good in quality.
correct_answer: All the items we bought at the shop were of high quality and at a low price.

question_tamil: அவன் என்னிடம் உண்மையை சொல்லியிருந்தால் நான் அவனுக்கு கண்டிப்பாக உதவி செய்திருப்பேன்.
tamil_transliteration: Avan ennidam unmaiyai solliyirundhaal naan avanukku kandippaaga udhavi seidhiruppaen.
options: If he had told me the truth, I would have definitely helped him.
He told me the truth, so I decided to help him without any doubt.
Unless he tells me the truth, I will not offer any help to him.
I helped him because he always speaks the truth to everyone.
correct_answer: If he had told me the truth, I would have definitely helped him.

question_tamil: மருத்துவர் கொடுத்த மருந்துகளை தவறாமல் சாப்பிட்டால் உனக்கு காய்ச்சல் விரைவில் குணமாகும்.
tamil_transliteration: Maruthuvar kodutha marundhugalai thavaraamal saappittaal unakku kaaichal viraivil gunamaagum.
options: If you take the medicines given by the doctor without fail, your fever will heal quickly.
You should go see a doctor immediately to get proper medicine for your fever.
Taking these fever medicines regularly will make you feel tired very soon.
After taking the doctor's medicine, your fever has completely recovered.
correct_answer: If you take the medicines given by the doctor without fail, your fever will heal quickly.

question_tamil: சாலையில் வாகனம் ஓட்டும்போது எப்போதும் பாதுகாப்பு வார் அணிவது நம் உயிருக்கு நல்லது.
tamil_transliteration: Saalaiyil vaaganam ottumbodhu eppodhum paadhugaappu vaar anivadhu nam uyirukku nalladhu.
options: Always wearing a seatbelt while driving on the road is good for our life safety.
You must drive carefully on the road to protect others from accidents.
Wearing seatbelts is mandatory only when driving fast on highways.
Never forget to check your vehicle condition before driving on busy roads.
correct_answer: Always wearing a seatbelt while driving on the road is good for our life safety.

question_tamil: அவர்கள் புதிய வீடு வாங்குவதற்காக கடந்த சில ஆண்டுகளாக பணத்தை சேமித்து வருகிறார்கள்.
tamil_transliteration: Avargal pudhiya veedu vaanguvadharkaaga kadandha sila aandugaalaaga panathai saemithu varugiraargal.
options: They have been saving money for the past few years to buy a new house.
They spent all their savings to renovate their old house last year.
Buying a new house requires planning and saving money for many years.
They are planning to sell their house to save money for the future.
correct_answer: They have been saving money for the past few years to buy a new house.

question_tamil: நீ விமான நிலையத்தை அடையும் போது எனக்கு ஒரு செய்தி அனுப்பு, நான் வந்து உன்னை அழைத்துச் செல்கிறேன்.
tamil_transliteration: Nee vimaana nilaiyathai adaiyum bodhu enakku oru seidhi anuppu, naan vandhu unnai alaithu chelgiraen.
options: Send me a message when you reach the airport, and I will come and pick you up.
Call me as soon as your flight lands so that I can leave from my home.
I am waiting at the airport to pick you up, so message me when you arrive.
When I reach the airport, I will send you a text message to inform you.
correct_answer: Send me a message when you reach the airport, and I will come and pick you up.

question_tamil: இந்த புத்தகத்தை வாசிப்பது மிகவும் பயனுள்ளதாக இருந்தது, நீயும் இதை கண்டிப்பாக வாசிக்க வேண்டும்.
tamil_transliteration: Indha puthagathai vaasippadhu migavum payanullaadhaaga irundhadhu, neeyum idhai kandippaaga vaasikka vaendum.
options: Reading this book was very useful, and you should definitely read it too.
I am reading a very useful book right now, which I will lend to you later.
This book is very long and difficult to read, so do not buy it.
You recommended a great book to me, and I enjoyed reading every chapter.
correct_answer: Reading this book was very useful, and you should definitely read it too.

question_tamil: எங்கள் விடுமுறை பயணத்தின் போது நாங்கள் பல அழகான இடங்களை கண்டு மகிழ்ந்தோம்.
tamil_transliteration: Engal vidumurai payanathin bodhu naangal pala azhagaana idangalai kandu magizhndhom.
options: During our vacation trip, we enjoyed seeing many beautiful places.
We are planning to visit many famous tourist spots during this holiday.
Our holiday trip was cancelled because the weather was not good.
Visiting beautiful places with family makes any vacation memorable.
correct_answer: During our vacation trip, we enjoyed seeing many beautiful places.

question_tamil: உனக்கு நேரம் கிடைக்கும் போது இந்த கோப்பை சரிபார்த்து எனக்கு தகவல் சொல்.
tamil_transliteration: Unakku naeram kidaikkum bodhu indha koppai saribaarthu enakku thagaval sol.
options: When you get time, please verify this file and let me know.
I will verify this file whenever I am free and send you an email.
Check this document immediately and send the details to the manager.
Do you have time now to go through these important files with me?
correct_answer: When you get time, please verify this file and let me know.

question_tamil: சூரியன் மறைந்த பிறகு காட்டில் தனியாக நடப்பது மிகவும் ஆபத்தானது.
tamil_transliteration: Sooriyan maraindha piragu kaattil thaniyaaga nadappadhu migavum aabathaanadhu.
options: Walking alone in the forest after sunset is very dangerous.
It is safe to walk in the forest only during early morning hours.
Sunset in the forest looks beautiful, but do not stay there late.
Going into the jungle at night without a guide is strictly prohibited.
correct_answer: Walking alone in the forest after sunset is very dangerous.

question_tamil: நீ தினமும் காலையில் உடற்பயிற்சி செய்தால் உனது உடல் ஆரோக்கியம் எப்போதும் சிறப்பாக இருக்கும்.
tamil_transliteration: Nee dhinamum kaalaiyil udarpayirtchi seidhaal unadhu udal aarokkiyam eppodhum sirappaaga irukkum.
options: If you exercise every morning, your physical health will always be excellent.
Morning exercise helps you stay energetic throughout the entire day.
To maintain good health, you should eat healthy food and exercise daily.
Exercising regularly in the evening is better than doing it in the morning.
correct_answer: If you exercise every morning, your physical health will always be excellent.

question_tamil: அவன் என்னிடம் எதுவும் சொல்லாமல் திடீரென்று வீட்டை விட்டு வெளியேறி விட்டான்.
tamil_transliteration: Avan ennidam edhum sollaamal thideerendru veettai vittu veliyaeri vittaan.
options: He left the house suddenly without saying anything to me.
He informed everyone before leaving the house this morning.
Why did he leave the room without telling anyone where he was going?
He suddenly called me from outside his house to share the news.
correct_answer: He left the house suddenly without saying anything to me.

question_tamil: இந்த கணினி மிகவும் மெதுவாக வேலை செய்வதால் என்னால் வேலையை விரைவில் முடிக்க முடியவில்லை.
tamil_transliteration: Indha kanini migavum medhuvaaga vaelai seivadhaal ennaal vaelaiyai viraivil mudikka mudiyavillai.
options: Because this computer works very slowly, I am unable to finish the work quickly.
My computer got repaired while I was trying to complete the task.
I need a new computer to speed up my daily work in the office.
Restarting the computer solved the slowness issue completely.
correct_answer: Because this computer works very slowly, I am unable to finish the work quickly.

question_tamil: நாளை காலை 10 மணிக்கு முக்கியமான கூட்டம் இருப்பதால் அனைவரும் தவறாமல் வந்துவிடவும்.
tamil_transliteration: Naalai kaalai 10 manikku mukkiyamaana koottam iruppadhaal anaivarum thavaraamal vandhuvidavum.
options: As there is an important meeting tomorrow at 10 AM, everyone please arrive without fail.
The meeting scheduled for tomorrow at 10 AM has been postponed to evening.
Everyone attended the important meeting today morning at 10 o'clock.
Please confirm if you can attend the 10 AM meeting tomorrow morning.
correct_answer: As there is an important meeting tomorrow at 10 AM, everyone please arrive without fail.

question_tamil: உணவகத்தில் நாங்கள் ஆர்டர் செய்த உணவு மிகவும் ருசியாகவும் சூடாகவும் இருந்தது.
tamil_transliteration: Unavagathil naangal order seidha unavu migavum rusiyaagavum soodaagavum irundhadhu.
options: The food we ordered at the restaurant was very delicious and hot.
We waited for a long time at the restaurant to get hot food.
The restaurant menu had many delicious items to order from.
Ordering hot food from the restaurant is convenient during night time.
correct_answer: The food we ordered at the restaurant was very delicious and hot.

question_tamil: நீ உன் நேரத்தை வீணடிக்காமல் பயனுள்ள காரியங்களில் கவனம் செலுத்த வேண்டும்.
tamil_transliteration: Nee un naerathai veenaadikkaamal payanulla kaariyangalil kavanam selutha vaendum.
options: Without wasting your time, you should focus on useful activities.
Managing time properly will help you achieve success in life.
Do not spend too much time on unproductive tasks every day.
You have a lot of time, so focus on completing your goals one by one.
correct_answer: Without wasting your time, you should focus on useful activities.

question_tamil: அவள் ஆங்கிலம் மற்றும் தமிழ் ஆகிய இரண்டு மொழிகளிலும் மிகச் சிறப்பாக பேசுவாள்.
tamil_transliteration: Aval aangilam matrum tamil aagiya irandu mozhigalilum migach sirappaaga paesuvaal.
options: She speaks very well in both English and Tamil languages.
Learning to speak English and Tamil is very easy for beginners.
She is trying to improve her English speaking skills in class.
Is she fluent in Tamil as well as English conversation?
correct_answer: She speaks very well in both English and Tamil languages.

question_tamil: வண்டியில் எரிபொருள் குறைவாக இருப்பதால் அருகில் உள்ள பெட்ரோல் பங்கிற்கு செல்ல வேண்டும்.
tamil_transliteration: Vandiyil eriborul kuraivaaga iruppadhaal arugil ulla petrol bunkirku sella vaendum.
options: Since fuel is low in the vehicle, we need to go to a nearby petrol station.
Fill the fuel tank completely before going on a long drive.
We ran out of fuel before reaching the nearest petrol bunk.
Is there any petrol pump near this road to refuel the car?
correct_answer: Since fuel is low in the vehicle, we need to go to a nearby petrol station.

question_tamil: குழந்தைகள் மாலையில் பூங்காவில் ஓடிப்பிடித்து விளையாடுவதை பார்ப்பதற்கு அழகாக இருக்கும்.
tamil_transliteration: Kuzhandhaigal maalaiyil poongaavil odippidithu vilaiyaaduvadhai paarpatharku azhagaaga irukkum.
options: It is beautiful to watch children running and playing in the park in the evening.
Children love going to the park every evening to play with their friends.
The park was crowded with many children playing various outdoor games.
Take the kids to the park in the evening so they can play freely.
correct_answer: It is beautiful to watch children running and playing in the park in the evening.

question_tamil: நான் சொன்னதை நீ சரியாக புரிந்து கொள்ளவில்லை என்றால் மீண்டும் ஒருமுறை விளக்குகிறேன்.
tamil_transliteration: Naan sonnadhai nee sariyaaga purindhu kollavillai endral meendum orumurai vilakkugiraen.
options: If you didn't understand what I said correctly, I will explain it once again.
Did you understand what I explained to you just now?
Please listen carefully so that I do not have to explain it again.
I understood your explanation clearly, so no need to repeat it.
correct_answer: If you didn't understand what I said correctly, I will explain it once again.

question_tamil: அவன் தனது கடின உழைப்பினால் மட்டுமே இந்த நிறுவனத்தின் மேலாளராக உயர்ந்துள்ளான்.
tamil_transliteration: Avan dhanadhu kadina uzhaippinaal mattumae indha niruvanathin maelaalaraaga uyarnthullaan.
options: Only through his hard work, he has risen to become the manager of this company.
He worked hard for many years to get promoted as a senior employee.
The manager of this company appreciated his dedication and hard work.
Hard work always leads to promotion in any organization.
correct_answer: Only through his hard work, he has risen to become the manager of this company.

question_tamil: இந்த வழியில் சென்றால் அரை மணி நேரத்தில் நாம் நகரத்தின் மையப்பகுதியை சென்றடையலாம்.
tamil_transliteration: Indha vazhiyil sendraal arai mani naerathil naam nagarathin maiyappagudhiyai sendradaiyalaam.
options: If we go by this route, we can reach the city center in half an hour.
It takes more than an hour to reach the city center due to traffic.
Which is the shortest route to reach the city center quickly?
We reached the middle of the city after driving for thirty minutes.
correct_answer: If we go by this route, we can reach the city center in half an hour.

question_tamil: எனக்கு இரவில் தாமதமாக தூங்கும் பழக்கம் உள்ளதால் காலையில் சீக்கிரம் எழ முடிவதில்லை.
tamil_transliteration: Enakku iravil thaamadhamaaga thoongum pazhakkam ulladhaal kaalaiyil seekiram ezha mudivadhillai.
options: Because I have the habit of sleeping late at night, I cannot wake up early in the morning.
Going to bed early at night will help you wake up early in the morning.
I woke up late today because I stayed awake watching a movie last night.
If you want to wake up early, you must change your sleeping habit.
correct_answer: Because I have the habit of sleeping late at night, I cannot wake up early in the morning.

question_tamil: நீ கேட்கும் கேள்விக்கு என்னிடம் இப்போது உடனடியாக பதில் எதுவும் இல்லை.
tamil_transliteration: Nee kaetkum kaelviku ennidam ippodhu udanadiyaaga badhil edhum illai.
options: I do not have an immediate answer right now to the question you are asking.
Ask me any question and I will give you the answer immediately.
I answered all your questions clearly during our discussion earlier.
Why are you asking such questions when you already know the answer?
correct_answer: I do not have an immediate answer right now to the question you are asking.

question_tamil: மழை நின்றவுடன் நாம் உடனே கடைக்கு சென்று தேவையான காய்கறிகளை வாங்கி வருவோம்.
tamil_transliteration: Mazhai nindravudan naam udanae kadaikku sendru thevaiyaana kaaigalai vaangi varuvom.
options: As soon as the rain stops, we will immediately go to the shop and buy needed vegetables.
We bought all the vegetables before it started raining heavily.
Wait until the rain stops before heading out to the market.
Going to the vegetable market in heavy rain is very difficult.
correct_answer: As soon as the rain stops, we will immediately go to the shop and buy needed vegetables.

question_tamil: உனது கைபேசியின் பேட்டரி குறையும் முன் அதை சார்ஜ் போடுவது நல்லது.
tamil_transliteration: Unadhu kaibaesiyin battery kuraiyum mun adhai charge poduvadhu nalladhu.
options: It is good to charge your mobile phone before its battery runs low.
My phone battery died because I forgot to charge it last night.
Carry a power bank so that your phone never runs out of battery.
Is your phone charger working properly to charge the battery fast?
correct_answer: It is good to charge your mobile phone before its battery runs low.

question_tamil: அவன் சொன்ன கதையை கேட்டு அங்கு இருந்த அனைவரும் உரக்க சிரிக்கத் தொடங்கினர்.
tamil_transliteration: Avan sonna kathaiyai kaettu angu irundha anaivarum urakka sirikka thodanginar.
options: Hearing the story he told, everyone present there started laughing loudly.
He tells funny stories that make everyone in the room laugh.
Everyone laughed at his joke because it was very hilarious.
The story he narrated was entertaining and enjoyed by all.
correct_answer: Hearing the story he told, everyone present there started laughing loudly.

question_tamil: நாம் எடுக்கும் ஒவ்வொரு முடிவும் நம் எதிர்கால வாழ்க்கையை தீர்மானிக்கிறது.
tamil_transliteration: Naam edukkum ovvoru mudivum nam edhirkaala vaazhkkaiyai theermaanikkiradhu.
options: Every decision we make determines our future life.
Think carefully before making decisions about your career.
Future life depends on how well we plan our goals today.
Important decisions should be taken with guidance from elders.
correct_answer: Every decision we make determines our future life.

question_tamil: நான் நேற்று இரவு பார்த்த திரைப்படம் மிகவும் சுவாரஸ்யமாகவும் உணர்ச்சிப்பூர்வமாகவும் இருந்தது.
tamil_transliteration: Naan naetru iravu paartha thiraippadam migavum suvaarasiyamaagavum unarchippoorvamaagavum irundhadhu.
options: The movie I watched last night was very interesting and emotional.
We watched a movie yesterday evening that was full of action and comedy.
Watching emotional movies at night makes it difficult to sleep.
Did you watch the new movie that released in theaters last night?
correct_answer: The movie I watched last night was very interesting and emotional.

question_tamil: நீ சொன்ன தகவலை வைத்து தான் நாங்கள் அந்த புதிய இடத்தை எளிதில் கண்டுபிடித்தோம்.
tamil_transliteration: Nee sonna thagavalai vaithu dhaan naangal antha pudhiya idathai elidhil kandupidithom.
options: Based on the information you gave, we easily found that new place.
Finding that new location without proper directions was very tough.
Thank you for giving us clear directions to reach the new spot.
Did you find the place easily using the location I shared?
correct_answer: Based on the information you gave, we easily found that new place.

question_tamil: அவள் தினமும் மாலையில் தன் பாட்டிக்கு தேவையான உதவிகளை அன்போடு செய்வாள்.
tamil_transliteration: Aval dhinamum maalaiyil dhan paattikku thevaiyaana udhavigalai anbodu seivaal.
options: She lovingly helps her grandmother with whatever she needs every evening.
Her grandmother loves it when she visits her every evening after school.
She takes care of her elderly grandmother at home with great love.
Helping elders at home is a habit she learned from a young age.
correct_answer: She lovingly helps her grandmother with whatever she needs every evening.

question_tamil: மின்சாரம் திடீரென்று தடைபட்டதால் வீட்டின் அனைத்து விளக்குகளும் அணைந்து விட்டன.
tamil_transliteration: Minsaaram thideerendru thadaipattadhaal veettin anaithu vilakkugalum anaindhu vittana.
options: Due to a sudden power outage, all the lights in the house went off.
Turn off all the lights when you leave the house to save electricity.
The power restored quickly after going off for a few minutes.
We lit candles in the house when the electricity went off suddenly.
correct_answer: Due to a sudden power outage, all the lights in the house went off.

question_tamil: உனக்கு இந்த வேலை செய்ய விருப்பம் இல்லை என்றால் அதை ஆரம்பத்திலேயே கூறி விடு.
tamil_transliteration: Unakku indha vaelai seiya viruppam illai endral adhai aarambathilaeyae koori vidu.
options: If you do not wish to do this work, say it right in the beginning.
Complete this work in the beginning before moving to other tasks.
Why didn't you inform us earlier that you cannot do this task?
If you need help doing this work, ask someone in the beginning.
correct_answer: If you do not wish to do this work, say it right in the beginning.

question_tamil: நாம் அனைவரும் இணைந்து செயல்பட்டால் எந்த பெரிய இலக்கையும் எளிதில் அடைய முடியும்.
tamil_transliteration: Naam anaivarum inaindhu seyalpattaal endha periya ilakkaiyum elidhil adaiya mudiyum.
options: If we all work together, we can easily achieve any big goal.
Teamwork is necessary when working on large projects with tight deadlines.
Achieving big goals requires individual dedication and hard work.
When everyone contributes, completing complex tasks becomes very simple.
correct_answer: If we all work together, we can easily achieve any big goal.

question_tamil: அவன் என்னிடம் மன்னிப்பு கேட்டதால் நான் அவனது பழைய தவறுகளை மறந்து விட்டேன்.
tamil_transliteration: Avan ennidam mannippu kaettadhaal naan avanadhu pazhaya thavarugalai marandhu vittaen.
options: Because he apologized to me, I forgot his past mistakes.
Forgiving someone when they apologize shows a good heart.
He made a mistake and apologized to everyone in the room.
I cannot forget what he did, even though he asked for forgiveness.
correct_answer: Because he apologized to me, I forgot his past mistakes.

question_tamil: இந்த பூங்காவில் உள்ள அழகான மலர்களை பறிக்கக் கூடாது என்று பலகையில் எழுதப்பட்டுள்ளது.
tamil_transliteration: Indha poongaavil ulla azhagaana malargalai parikka koodaadhu endru palagaiyil ezhudhappattulladhu.
options: It is written on the board that beautiful flowers in this park should not be plucked.
Do not touch or pluck the flowers in the garden as per park rules.
The flowers blooming in the park look very colorful and attractive.
The sign board warns visitors not to damage any plants in the garden.
correct_answer: It is written on the board that beautiful flowers in this park should not be plucked.

question_tamil: நான் சிறுவயதில் இந்த கிராமத்தில் தான் எனது குடும்பத்தோடு வசசித்து வந்தேன்.
tamil_transliteration: Naan siruvayadhil indha giraamathil dhaan enadhu kudumbathodu vasithu vandhaen.
options: In my childhood, I used to live in this village with my family.
My family moved to this village when I was very young.
Visiting my childhood village brings back many pleasant memories.
This village is where my grandparents lived for several decades.
correct_answer: In My childhood, I used to live in this village with my family.

question_tamil: உனது பயணப் பையை கவனமாக பூட்டி வை, அதில் முக்கியமான பொருட்கள் உள்ளன.
tamil_transliteration: Unadhu payanap paiyai kavanamaaga pootti vai, adhil mukkiyamaana porutkal ullana.
options: Lock your travel bag carefully, as it contains important items.
Keep all your valuable items inside the travel bag securely.
Did you lock your luggage before leaving it at the hotel desk?
Do not leave your travel bag unattended in public places.
correct_answer: Lock your travel bag carefully, as it contains important items.

question_tamil: அவன் எப்போதும் பிறருக்கு உதவி செய்யும் நல்ல குணம் கொண்ட மனிதன்.
tamil_transliteration: Avan eppodhum pirarukku udhavi seiyum nalla gunam konda manidhan.
options: He is a good-natured person who always helps others.
Helping others in need is his greatest quality and habit.
Everyone respects him because he is always ready to offer help.
A person who helps others will always be loved by society.
correct_answer: He is a good-natured person who always helps others.

question_tamil: நீங்கள் இணையத்தில் பணப்பரிவர்த்தனை செய்யும்போது மிகவும் எச்சரிக்கையாக இருக்க வேண்டும்.
tamil_transliteration: Neengal inaiyathil panapparivarthanai seiyumbodhu migavum echarikkaiyaaga irukka vaendum.
options: You should be very cautious when making financial transactions online.
Online transactions are fast and convenient for daily payments.
Never share your OTP or passwords during online money transfers.
Always check payment details before confirming any transaction online.
correct_answer: You should be very cautious when making financial transactions online.

question_tamil: மழையினால் ஏற்பட்ட வெள்ளம் காரணமாக பேருந்து போக்குவரத்து முற்றிலும் பாதிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.
tamil_transliteration: Mazhaiyinaal aerpatta vellam kaaranamaaga paerundhu pokkuvarathu mutrilum baadhikkappattulladhu.
options: Due to flooding caused by rain, bus transport has been completely affected.
Heavy rain disrupted train services across the city since morning.
Buses are running slowly due to waterlogging on major roads.
Check traffic updates before travelling during heavy rainy seasons.
correct_answer: Due to flooding caused by rain, bus transport has been completely affected.

question_tamil: நான் உனக்கு அனுப்பிய புகைப்படங்களை பார்த்துவிட்டு உனது கருத்தை சொல்.
tamil_transliteration: Naan unakku anuppiya pugaippadangalai paarthuvittu unadhu karuthai sol.
options: Look at the photos I sent you and give your opinion.
I sent some photos to your email, check them when free.
What did you think of the pictures I took during our trip?
Please share those photos with everyone in the group chat.
correct_answer: Look at the photos I sent you and give your opinion.

question_tamil: அவள் சமையலறையில் சுவையான உணவை தயாரித்துக் கொண்டிருக்கும் போது நறுமணம் வீசியது.
tamil_transliteration: Aval samaiyalaraiyil suvaiyaana unavai thayaarithuk kondirukkum bodhu narumanam veesiyadhu.
options: A pleasant aroma wafted while she was preparing delicious food in the kitchen.
She cooks delicious meals in the kitchen for her family every day.
The food being cooked in the kitchen smelled so good and fresh.
Help her in the kitchen while she prepares food for the guests.
correct_answer: A pleasant aroma wafted while she was preparing delicious food in the kitchen.

question_tamil: நீ எப்போது புதிய கார் வாங்க திட்டமிட்டுள்ளாய் என்பதை என்னிடம் தெரிவி.
tamil_transliteration: Nee eppodhu pudhiya car vaanga thittamittullaai enbadhai ennidam therivi.
options: Let me know when you are planning to buy a new car.
Are you buying a new car this month or waiting for discounts?
He bought a new car last week after saving for months.
Which model of car are you planning to purchase this year?
correct_answer: Let me know when you are planning to buy a new car.

question_tamil: வெற்றியை கண்டு பெருமை கொள்ளாமலும் தோல்வியைக் கண்டு சோர்வடையாமலும் வாழ வேண்டும்.
tamil_transliteration: Vetriyai kandu perumai kollamaalum tholviyai kandu sorvadaiyaamalum vaazha vaendum.
options: One should live without being arrogant in victory or discouraged in defeat.
Success and failure are both temporary parts of human life.
Learn to celebrate small victories without fearing future failures.
Facing defeats bravely will lead you to eventual success in life.
correct_answer: One should live without being arrogant in victory or discouraged in defeat.
